findings.title: Historical desktop Patreon OAuth-secret exposure path
findings.evidence: The prior desktop architecture included local Patreon runtime configuration and build helpers capable of packaging OAuth configuration. The new server-owned flow removes those files from source/build inputs. A clean temporary EXE has zero retired-module and exact-local-value hits, but public historical artifacts were not exhaustively recovered and inspected.
findings.remediation: Confirm whether a real client secret was ever shipped. Rotate it before production if yes or uncertain. Keep all future OAuth secrets in Worker secret bindings.

findings.title: Raw OAuth token forwarding through application deep links
findings.evidence: The completion page now forwards only code and normalized error fields, applies CSP/no-referrer/no-store, Android filters are narrowed, and unsafe token fragments are rejected.
findings.remediation: Covered by scripts/test-membership-security.mjs and Android lint/unit gates.

findings.title: Client-influenced membership activation and badge display
findings.evidence: Activation now depends on server-verified LAVA/Patreon state. Public badges come from authenticated server profile state, and participant-supplied tiers are overridden.
findings.remediation: Keep the Worker/D1/Supabase state authoritative and retain negative tests for forged tiers and redirects.

findings.title: Known LAVA development dependency advisories
findings.evidence: Cloudflare/Vitest/Wrangler development dependencies were upgraded and the resulting npm audit reports zero known vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Production migrations, secrets, and provider callbacks are not verified
findings.evidence: No production mutation was authorized. D1/Supabase migrations and LAVA/Patreon sandbox/live configuration remain unapplied during this audit.
findings.remediation: Apply to sandbox, execute SECURITY_TEST_PLAN.md, then obtain explicit owner approval for production.

findings.title: Android dependency advisory scan coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: Android unit tests and lint pass, but an independent OSV/OWASP dependency vulnerability report was not available in the local toolchain.
findings.remediation: Add a compatible Android dependency scanner to CI and triage reachable high/critical findings before release.

findings.title: Production Supabase/Firebase policy verification remains external
findings.evidence: Public client identifiers are intentionally present in the Android client; their safety depends on server authorization, RLS, API restrictions, and production Firebase/Supabase policy that was not mutated or fully inspected here.
findings.remediation: Verify RLS, storage policies, API restrictions, App Check/abuse controls, and authorized domains in the production dashboards.

findings.title: Stale local MVDownloader build artifacts use the retired membership module architecture
findings.evidence: Existing ignored local artifacts may contain the retired module marker. They were not deleted or selected for release. The clean temporary build does not contain it.
findings.remediation: Release only clean artifacts built from the reviewed commit; do not upload stale local build directories.
